d: An IndiGo flight made an emergency landing in Pune after a technical malfunction was reported in its landing gear. There were 192 people on board when the incident occurred, triggering an emergency response at the airport. The aircraft was reportedly facing difficulties related to its landing gear, prompting the crew to take precautionary measures and carry out an emergency landing. The incident raised concerns over passenger safety and aircraft maintenance. What exactly happened onboard? How did the crew handle the technical issue, and were all passengers safe?
